classes.label: Planet candidate
classes.rule: Passed vetting, labelled a potential planet by half the panel's weight, not off its star's own periodic signal, and taken by no rule above. A candidate, unconfirmed.
classes.confidence: medium: on a periodic signal with two or more transits, neither V-shaped nor density-mismatched; low: otherwise. Never high.

classes.label: Eclipsing binary
classes.rule: Odd/even depth mismatch or secondary eclipse; or a depth of 30,000 ppm or more; or V-shaped and 5,000 ppm or more; or half the panel's weight saying eclipsing binary. Variability at an eclipsing binary's period, or half of it.
classes.confidence: high: odd/even mismatch or secondary eclipse; medium: depth or V shape, or the eclipse period; low: the panel's reason alone.

classes.label: Flare
classes.rule: A brightening: 3 or more consecutive points at least 3σ above a 0.5-day running median, peaking at 5σ or more, against both the star's scatter and the scatter within 0.25 d; not on an instrumental cue.
classes.confidence: high: 5 or more points, a peak of 10σ or more and a faster rise than decay; medium: two of those; low: otherwise.

classes.label: Pulsator or rotational variable
classes.rule: A periodogram peak with Baluev FAP below 0.001 and a semi-amplitude at least 2× the scatter of 10-minute bins. A dip lasting 0.25 of that period or more is a trough of it; so is a dip half the panel's weight called stellar variability.
classes.confidence: high: FAP below 1e-10 and a semi-amplitude 5× the binned scatter or more; medium: semi-amplitude 3× or more; low: otherwise (or a dip by the panel's reason alone).

classes.label: Systematic
classes.rule: On an instrumental cue: a subject edge; a momentum dump, a scattered-light flag or a pointing or manual-exclude flag within 0.1 d; a data gap over 0.5 d within 0.1 d; or half the panel's weight calling it instrumental.
classes.confidence: high: two or more instrumental cues; medium: one; low: the panel's reason alone.

classes.label: Unclassified
classes.rule: Everything else, with the reason no class applied.
